facts = sql_program(
    queries={"rows": "SELECT label, CAST(value AS BIGINT) AS value FROM (VALUES ('FY2023', 10), ('FY2024', 20), ('FY2025', 33)) AS source(label, value) ORDER BY label"},
    outputs={"rows": relation_output(columns=[relation_field("label", Utf8), relation_field("value", Int64)], row_key=("label",), order_by=("label",))},
)()
table(category="Facts", title="Native computed facts")(key=facts.rows.label, values=facts.rows.value)
